Markt: eine Ware suchen oder in den Ware: Market: search an item or pick it in the market groups – prices in the 5 hubs side by side and the order book (hubs only, region or radius).
Kontostand, Einnahmen und Ausgaben deine: Balance, income and expenses of your characters from the EVE wallet: overview, transactions, journal and the history of your net worth. Needs a logged-in character.
Alles, was deine Charaktere besitzen, na: Everything your characters own, sorted by location – with estimated value and your ships including fittings to copy. Needs a logged-in character.
Zeigt für deine Sachen an einem Ort, wo: Shows where nearby you get the best price for your items at one location. Pick a character, click “Load assets”, choose the location and start the analysis.
Deine offenen Kauf- und Verkaufsaufträge: Your open buy and sell orders of all characters and the history of your recent orders.
Die Verträge aller deiner Charaktere – l: The contracts of all your characters – ongoing and finished.
Industrie-Jobs, Mining Ledger und Bluepr: Industry jobs, mining ledger and blueprints of your characters. EVE Omni suggests the character with the best skills for each task.
Erz-Rechner: was sich beim Abbau gerade: Ore calculator: what is worth mining right now – raw, compressed or refined, with ISK per hour.
Skills, Skillpunkte und Trainings-Wartes: Skills, skill points and training queue of all logged-in characters, plus skill plans and which trade skills are worth training.
Routen planen: Reiseroute, die gefährlic: Plan routes: travel route that can avoid dangerous systems, map, jump planner for jump-capable ships and route planner (DOTLAN).
Local-Bedrohung: Mitgliederliste aus dem: Local threat: paste the member list from EVE Local (Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C, here Ctrl+V) – EVE Omni shows how dangerous the pilots are according to zKillboard.
Alle Charaktere auf einen Blick: Standor: All characters at a glance: location, online status, ship, skill queue, implants and clones – plus your planets (PI).
Jukebox: Musik aus deinen Ordnern oder I: Jukebox: music from your folders or internet radio, with your own playlists.
Watchlist: alle gemerkten Trades und Hau: Watchlist: all saved trades and hauling runs – active, done or cancelled, with profit or loss.
Radar: Gate-Camps im Umkreis laut zKillb: Radar: gate camps nearby according to zKillboard.
Wurmlöcher: J-Systeme mit Klasse, Effekt: Wormholes: J-systems with class, effect, statics and planets, plus all wormhole types (data from anoik.is).
Wertschätzer: Liste aus dem Inventar ode: Appraisal: paste a list from your inventory or a contract and get it valued at a trade hub.
Kurier: öffentliche Kurierverträge, sort: Courier: public courier contracts, sorted by ISK per jump and per hour.
Log in your EVE characters here. Login runs through CCP – EVE Omni never sees your password.
Die kurzen Erklärungen oben auf jeder Se: The short explanations at the top of each page appear again.
Findet Waren, die du an einem Ort billig: Finds goods you buy cheaply in one place and sell with profit elsewhere – matching ship, cargo, budget and gank protection. In ① choose where to buy and sell (one or more hubs, an own system or everything in a radius), in ② the ship, in ③ budget and how to sell – then search at the top.
Findet am gewählten Handelsknoten Waren,: Finds items at the chosen trade hub where buying with a buy order and reselling with a sell order pays off. Set capital and fees at the top, then click “Scan trades”. Saved trades are listed under “My trades”.
